newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin rebounds five cents to 14.99 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL tin rebounds five cents to 14.99 rgt.

text.p: Tin price rebounded to end five cents higher at 14.99 ringgit ($6.00) a kg as the market took its cue from the London market, traders said.

"The market was firmer. Sentiment was helped by gains in London," a trader said, adding that increased buying from overseas also helped prices. Bids at the opening totalled 233 tonnes against offers for 99 tonnes. Turnover rose to 144 tonnes against 96 on Wednesday with buying from Europe, Malaysia and Japan. The local price differential over London was at $25 a tonne premium against $65 previously.
